title: Netanyahu review of Haifa ammonia-tank closure delay
summary: 2017 government meeting in which Netanyahu asked ministers and officials to examine delaying the court-ordered closure while his office denied that acquaintance with Jules Trump influenced the decision.

sources.title: Netanyahu seeks to delay closure of controversial ammonia tank

data.name: Netanyahu review of Haifa ammonia-tank closure delay
data.description: Prime ministerial meeting on delaying closure of the Haifa ammonia tank and preserving fertilizer-industry employment.
data.outcome: Government explored or sought a short delay; the PMO denied influence from Netanyahu's acquaintance with Jules Trump.
